derivation: of Chaldean origin (H0426 with pronominal suffix) my God

occurrences.text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
